response.sql: SELECT a.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY tr.ordertypedist) AS frac FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr >= 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY frac DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: 'At least 0.149' means peercorr >= 0.149; rows with a NULL peercorr are excluded.

The inner join drops advanced-behaviour rows with no matching transaction record, as the request says. Since transactionrecord.transreg is the primary key, each translink matches at most one transaction record, so COUNT(*) counts advancedbehavior rows per (translink, ordertypedist) group.

The denominator for the fraction is the sum of counts over the filtered result (qualifying advanced-behaviour rows, with NULL order type mixes removed) for the same ordertypedist, not the whole table.
Ties in the fraction are left in arbitrary order; the request names no tiebreaker.
